# Kervin Sarmiento

> Full Stacked Developer and freelancer in Iloilo City, Philippines. He builds web apps and desktop apps like Gabay and is open for freelance work and internships. BS Information Technology student, 3rd year, University of San Agustin.

Contact is by email or Instagram. There is no LinkedIn account and no booking link.

## Projects

- [Mind Bridge](https://mind-bridge-omega.vercel.app): his capstone, a student wellness platform for the University of San Agustin (React, Firebase)
- [ACUA](https://acua-three.vercel.app): a storefront for handmade accessories with GCash and bank-transfer checkout and a custom commission flow (React, Supabase)
- [Gabay](https://gabay-site-plum.vercel.app): a free, open-source Windows app that folds the taskbar into an iPhone-style notch (Electron, React, TypeScript)
- [Kape Lokal](https://kape-lokal.vercel.app): a local cafe finder for Iloilo City (Next.js, Supabase, MapLibre)
- [UTM Esports](https://utm-esports.vercel.app): the website for the UTM Esports team, in development; his first project with Cascade Development Group, where he is listed on https://cdgsolutions.dev/team (Next.js, React)
- [Nuwave Specialty Coffee](https://nuwave-blond.vercel.app): a table-QR menu and website for a coffee shop in Jaro, Iloilo City
